domains.name: Comprensione della Lettura — Reading (academic, literary, and specialised texts; inferential reading)
Produzione Scritta — Writing (analytical report, critical essay, formal professional correspondence)
Comprensione dell'Ascolto — Listening (academic lectures, complex interviews, specialised discussions)
Produzione Orale — Speaking (sustained argumentation, nuanced discussion, professional register)

exam_price_notes: Approx. €110–€130 (~$121–$143 USD) depending on exam centre
exam_rules: No electronic devices or reference materials permitted. Oral exams conducted in person with a trained examiner. Listening tasks are played via audio recording; earphones not provided.
id_requirements: Valid government-issued photo ID (passport, national identity card, or equivalent) required at the exam centre.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-20: "Il CELI 4 attesta la conoscenza della lingua italiana al livello C1 del Quadro Comune Europeo di Riferimento."

official_study_resources.title: CELI Esempi di Prove d'Esame (Official Sample Papers)
CILS Materiali di Preparazione (Official Sample Papers)

prerequisites.description: None; recommended ~700+ hours of Italian study. Recognised for professional and academic purposes across Italy and internationally.

renewal_options: CELI and CILS certificates have lifetime validity — they do not expire.

retake_policy.notes: No official waiting period. Candidates may re-sit at the next available exam session (exams held 2–4 times per year depending on centre and level).
